## Working session summary

Every acceptance item in issue #11 is implemented and tested, CI passes, and PR https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/pull/12 is marked ready for review. It says "Fixes #11" and has embedded screenshots.

**What changed**
- **Experience matches hh.ru.**
  - Evirma and Capico are added.
  - Kaiten, Deep.Foundation, ArtBridge, Abracar, ELAR, Termika, Pegas, AlpOnline and AsgardRo have the issue's dates, real job titles, achievements and stacks.
  - LinksPlatform stays 2010 – present.
  - The 18 years of experience are computed rather than typed in, so the number grows over time.
  - Russian company legal names (ООО «Абракар», АО «ЭЛАР», ЗАО «Термика») appear on the Russian side.
- **9 new positions**, each with English and Russian text, its own jobs, skills and CV. The old ones are kept and all of them can be picked on the experience page.
- **CV download** from the home page and the experience page:
```text
  - The new `/cv/` page lets you pick one of 15 positions, 4 styles (classic, compact, technical, academic) and EN or RU.
  - The Pages workflow prints all 120 combinations to PDF and publishes them under `/cv/pdf/`.
  - The build fails if:
    - a CV for a position runs past 2 pages;
    - a compact CV runs past 1 page;
    - a PDF has no selectable text;
    - the layout would scramble the text order an ATS reads.
- **Light/dark themes and EN/RU** on every page. Both are auto-detected and have a switch that is remembered; the language also works with `?lang=`. The CV preview follows the theme, but the PDF is always black on white.
```

**Things to know**
- The longest CV for a position takes 1.78 pages. The full CV with no position keeps every job and takes 3 pages; the issue sets no limit for it.
- To fit the Developer CV in 2 pages, any position with more than 10 jobs lists jobs that ended before 2015 on a single "Earlier experience" line.
- My first PDFs put every job's bullet points after the last job in the extracted text, which is what an ATS reads. The cause was the custom bullet style; switching to plain list bullets fixed it.
- The correct order was checked by eye on samples of each style. The build check guards against the cause in all 120 PDFs; it doesn't compare the text order itself.
- Termika's Selenium load-testing line is on neither hh.ru nor LinkedIn. It comes from Habr Career, so I kept it and the text names that source.

**Verification**
- `npm run check` and the 341 tests pass, and the build and PDF printing pass locally.
- A Python (pypdf) text extraction checked all 120 PDFs with no failures. It looks for the contacts and section headings, the section order, and that no phone, email, birth date or salary appears.
- The CI run for the last commit passed, including printing the PDFs.
- There are no comments on the issue or the PR. Main has no new commits.

The full analysis, with a requirement-by-requirement table and the screenshots, is in `docs/case-studies/issue-11/README.md`. The README now covers the `/cv/` page, `npm run build:cv` and the new data files.
